visualIdentity.identity: A support triage desk that puts at-risk tickets, remaining SLA time, and escalation controls ahead of generic ticket browsing.
visualIdentity.rationale: Ticket SLA uses a domain-specific first viewport, information scent, and palette instead of a repeated dashboard skin.

render.firstViewport: Open the at-risk queue, review remaining hours, and change ticket status without leaving triage.
